items.heading: Bipc Is the Intermediate Name
items.text: Bipc Is the Intermediate Name Bipc Is the Intermediate Name BiPC is the Intermediate name for Botany, Zoology, Physics and Chemistry, the same stream others call PCB. Nobody publishes one official figure for "high", so the table below shows what public pay samples say for each route.

items.heading: Several More Courses Come Up
items.text: Several more courses come up in BiPC searches. No pay band is quoted for them because no sample was strong enough, so read the notes below as a map and check live job posts.
